issues.finding: The abstract explicitly says RL-only. Delta(RL,SFT) is an arm contrast, not a proven incremental SFT-to-RL gain.
issues.action: Correct the earlier plan wording and all draft discussion.

issues.finding: General EX: all minus exec+syntax=64.01-62.84=1.17 pp. FS EX:70.66-68.97=1.69 pp. General EX all minus exec-only=64.01-62.32=1.69 pp.
issues.action: State both metric and reward baseline; do not repeat approximately 1.7 for exec+syntax ordinary EX.

issues.finding: 7B direct-SFT FS EX is 69.23 in Table 1 but 68.12 in Table 2. Ordinary EX=61.53 agrees.
issues.action: Use Table 2 consistently for multi-size panel; flag inconsistency, do not combine cells from different tables.

issues.finding: PICARD body reports TS=71.9; CodeS re-evaluation reports TS=69.4 for T5-3B+PICARD. EX=79.3 agrees.
issues.action: Table 9 reports primary EX; do not substitute or harmonize TS values.

issues.finding: Its Table II labels BIRD 23.34 as T5-3B+PICARD, but CodeS Table 6 labels that number as fine-tuned T5-3B without a PICARD claim.
issues.action: Do not carry this BIRD cell into PICARD Table 9 row.

issues.finding: CodeS-15B is initialized from StarCoder-15B, while smaller versions use StarCoderBase. Using StarCoderBase-15B changes the pretraining deltas.
issues.action: Use the actual parent row and document the different warm start.

issues.finding: XiYan-SQL has a TKDE April 2026 version. FINER-SQL has an ICDE 2026 publication record despite a preprint title on arXiv.
issues.action: Separate checked numerical version, archival status, and independent replication; update manuscript and appendix.

issues.finding: CodeS-3B BIRD +EK rises from39.18 to55.02 (+15.84 pp), but SFT and ICL have different retrieval top-k budgets and demonstrations.
issues.action: Describe a full-regime comparison, not a controlled SFT-only effect.
